Container.Name: uhf-server
Container.Overview:
UHF Server is the DVR backend for the "UHF - Love Your IPTV" app. It records live IPTV streams to HLS, serves a built-in web app and API on a single port, and can optionally run Comskip commercial detection on finished recordings so ad breaks can be skipped.
Connect from the UHF app under Settings > DVR server using your Unraid IP and port, or open the WebUI in a browser.
SECURITY: If no password is set, anyone on your network can use the server. Set a password if the server is reachable beyond a trusted LAN.
Set the Recordings path to a location on an array/pool share with plenty of free space. Keep the Database path on appdata (cache/SSD preferred).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web app. The container always listens on 8000; change the host port here if 8000 is already in use.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Folder where recordings are stored (one folder per recording). Point this at a share with plenty of free space.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: Stores the database (schedules, recording states, web sessions). Keep this on persistent storage.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional password for the apps and web app. Leave empty for no password protection. Changing it ends existing web sessions.

Config.Name: Commercial Detection
Config.Description: Run Comskip on finished recordings so ad breaks can be skipped. Uses CPU and takes minutes per recording.

Config.Name: API Port (internal)
Config.Description: Port the server listens on inside the container. Must match the container port of the port mapping above; leave at 8000.

Config.Name: Single File Recordings
Config.Description: Merge segments into a single index.ts file after recording. Temporarily needs twice the recording's disk space.
